attributes.name: Miniature Pinscher
attributes.description: The Miniature Pinscher is a small breed of dog that originated in Germany. It is a compact and lively breed, with a short, smooth coat. Its head is large and round, with small, erect ears. Its legs are short and strong, and its tail is usually docked. The Miniature Pinscher is an intelligent and loyal breed, and it makes an excellent family pet. It is an active breed, and it needs regular exercise and mental stimulation. It is loyal and affectionate, and it enjoys being around its family.
